mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sns_board (user_no, restaurant_id, title, content, board_img, board_tag, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{restaurantId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{boardImg}, #{boardTag}, now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE sns_board SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, title = #{title}, board_img = #{boardImg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE board_id = #{boardId}

UPDATE menu m JOIN ( SELECT menu_id, SUM(menu_rating) AS rating_sum, COUNT(*) AS img_count FROM sns_board_image WHERE board_id = #{boardId} GROUP BY menu_id ) AS img ON m.menu_id = img.menu_id SET m.total_rating = m.total_rating - img.rating_sum, m.review_count = m.review_count - img.img_count;

UPDATE restaurants r JOIN ( SELECT b.restaurant_id, COALESCE(SUM(i.menu_rating), 0) AS rating_sum, COUNT(i.image_id) AS image_count FROM sns_board b LEFT JOIN sns_board_image i ON b.board_id = i.board_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId} GROUP BY b.restaurant_id ) AS x ON r.restaurant_id = x.restaurant_id SET r.total_rating = r.total_rating - x.rating_sum, r.total_contents = GREATEST(r.total_contents - 1, 0), r.review_counts = GREATEST(r.review_counts - x.image_count, 0);
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, b.title, b.content, r.restaurant_name AS restaurantName, b.board_img AS boardImg, b.board_tag AS boardTag, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt, b.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickName, u.user_img AS userImg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sns_like WHERE board_id = b.board_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sns_comment WHERE board_id = b.board_id) AS commentCount, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM sns_like WHERE board_id = b.board_id AND user_no = #{myUserNo} ) AS isLiked FROM sns_board b INNER JOIN user u ON b.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN restaurants r ON b.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.title, b.content, b.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, r.restaurant_name AS restaurantName, r.category AS category, b.board_img AS boardImg, b.board_tag AS boardTag, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt, b.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickName, u.user_img AS userImg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sns_like WHERE board_id = b.board_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sns_comment WHERE board_id = b.board_id) AS commentCount, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM sns_like WHERE board_id = b.board_id AND user_no = #{myUserNo} ) AS isLiked FROM sns_board b INNER JOIN user u ON b.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN restaurants r ON b.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.title, b.content, b.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, r.restaurant_name AS restaurantName, b.board_img AS boardImg, b.board_tag AS boardTag, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt, b.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickName, u.user_img AS userImg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sns_like WHERE board_id = b.board_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sns_comment WHERE board_id = b.board_id) AS commentCount, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM sns_like WHERE board_id = b.board_id AND user_no = #{myUserNo} ) AS isLiked FROM sns_board b INNER JOIN user u ON b.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN restaurants r ON b.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id WHERE b.user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.title, r.restaurant_name AS restaurantName, b.content, b.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, b.board_img AS boardImg, b.board_tag AS boardTag, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt, b.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickName, u.user_img AS userImg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sns_like WHERE board_id = b.board_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sns_comment WHERE board_id = b.board_id) AS commentCount, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM sns_like WHERE board_id = b.board_id AND user_no = #{myUserNo} ) AS isLiked FROM sns_board b INNER JOIN user u ON b.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN restaurants r ON b.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id WHERE b.restaurant_id = #{restaurantId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sns_board_image (board_id, image_url, image_order) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageOrder})

INSERT INTO sns_board_image ( board_id, image_url, image_order, menu_rating, menu_id, one_line_review, created_at ) VALUES
( #{boardId}, #{image.imageUrl}, (#{idx} + 1), #{image.menuRating}, #{image.menuId}, #{image.oneLineReview}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET total_rating = COALESCE(total_rating, 0) + #{rating}, review_count = COALESCE(review_count, 0) + 1 WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}

UPDATE restaurants SET total_rating = COALESCE(total_rating, 0) + #{sumRating}, review_counts = COALESCE(review_counts, 0) + #{count}, total_contents = COALESCE(total_contents, 0) + 1 WHERE restaurant_id = #{restaurantId}
mapper.select: SELECT sbi.image_id AS imageId, sbi.board_id AS boardId, sbi.menu_id AS menuId, sbi.image_url AS imageUrl, sbi.image_order AS imageOrder, sbi.created_at AS createdAt, sbi.menu_rating AS menuRating, sbi.one_line_review AS oneLineReview, m.menu_name AS menuName FROM sns_board_image sbi LEFT JOIN menu m ON sbi.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY image_order ASC
